vulnerability.explanation: When inserting an element that is already present, the code frees the previously stored element via fnFreeEltFunc(*pElt) (line 447) and then unconditionally assigns *pElt = elt (line 449). If elt is the same pointer as the existing element (e.g., default pointer equality), this frees the pointer and stores the same freed pointer back into the set. Subsequent destruction/removal of the set will free it again, causing a double free, and any lookup may return a dangling pointer (use-after-free).
